subtopics.title: Training Data Selection and Quality
subtopics.summary: Choosing and validating the data used for pre-training and post-training, including data quality, quantity, and synthesis methods that impact model alignment and capabilities.

subtopics.title: Model Architecture and Scaling
subtopics.summary: Architectural choices such as transformer blocks, attention mechanisms, and scaling decisions that determine model capacity and training bottlenecks.

subtopics.title: Post-Training Finetuning Strategies
subtopics.summary: Decisions around supervised finetuning (SFT) and preference finetuning to align model outputs with user intent after pre-training.

subtopics.title: Hyperparameter Optimization
subtopics.summary: Selection of learning rates, batch sizes, and other training hyperparameters that affect convergence, cost, and final model performance.

subtopics.title: Training Efficiency and Cost Management
subtopics.summary: Techniques to make training faster and cheaper, including quantization, pruning, and resource allocation decisions.
